description: Prepare a public availability booking link for the user’s email draft, using an existing host calendar service and optional resource. The recipient opens it, sees live availability in the host timezone and chooses a time. A successful booking automatically creates a branded video room, including when the selected service normally describes an in-person appointment. Link preparation itself reserves no time and sends no invitation or email. First read options with get_meeting_availability; never invent service/resource names. Return only the server-supplied bookingUrl, expiry and host timezone. It is not a guest room link yet. Do not alter the business’s ordinary public booking defaults or promise a room before a visitor successfully books. Sending the draft still requires the user’s explicit send action.
name: prepare_booking_link
